name: Independiente 1972-1975
scopeNote: Club Atlético Independiente, four consecutive Copa Libertadores (1972-1975) and 1973 Intercontinental Cup. Sources call the defence 'achique' with offside line and a 'cuatro-dos-cuatro' (El Gráfico 1975); the popular 'Rey de Copas' label is a trophy label, not a style. Start is given as year only: the first 1972 Libertadores match day was not found (web search budget exhausted). End 1975-06-29 is the Asunción decider (Infobae, 442). Managers rotated (Dellacha 1972, Maschio 1973, Ferreiro 1974, Dellacha 1975); exact change dates not found, years taken from Aire de Santa Fe.
openQuestions: Exact dates of coaching changes (Dellacha to Maschio, Maschio to Ferreiro, Ferreiro to Dellacha) were not found; managers[] uses years only.
First match date of Independiente in the 1972 Copa Libertadores not found; profilePeriod.start is 1972.
El Gráfico 'Epopeya Roja' mentions 'Pipo' as DT in 1973; identity (Maschio nickname?) not confirmed and a speaker named Ferreiro appears (probably the ex-player, not verified).
Marking system (zonal vs man) not directly stated; El Gráfico 1975 describes 'achique', offside and 'hombres de marca' only; no source found for set-pieces beyond Bertoni free kick.
Wikipedia 1973 Intercontinental Cup mirrors list Ferreiro as coach in 1973 while Aire de Santa Fe gives Maschio; not resolved.
Web search budget was exhausted before the planned gap pass; only 7 searches (a,b,c-ish,d,e,f) ran, with no dedicated zonal/man-marking page found.
